messages:
sam.sre: Heads up — we're seeing a sustained spike of 502s and upstream timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west2a starting ~09:40 UTC. Gateway error rate up ~7x, p99 latency for gateway climbing. Tickets from multiple customers. Anyone from network able to check peering?

emma-support: Copy. Filing incident INC-4598 and pinging customers. Can you paste p50/p95/p99 for gateway and backend?

sam.sre: Quick numbers from the last 10m:

```
gateway.requests.total: 12.4k
gateway.5xx.rate: 7.1% (baseline ~0.4%)
gateway.latency.p50/p95/p99: 60ms / 420ms / 1.9s
backend.kvcache.hit-rate: 78% (unchanged)
auth.retries.rate: +320% coincident spike
```

sam.sre: Logs show a lot of `upstream connection reset` and `504 read timeout` from our edge -> transit POP.

raj-net: I'm on it. Seeing multiple BGP adjacency flaps with provider ASN 64522 from eu-west2a pop -> transit splice. Also intermittent ICMP loss and packet reordering on path to provider-edge. Starting traceroutes and packet-capture on the affected fabric.

raj-net: traceroute snippet (09:47 UTC):
```
traceroute to transit-edge (198.51.100.12), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.2.1  0.39 ms  0.36 ms  0.34 ms
 2  198.51.100.1  1.22 ms  1.19 ms  1.21 ms
 3  *  *  *  (intermittent hops, high jitter)
 4  198.51.100.12  80.2 ms  1.1 ms  79.9 ms
```

raj-net: Packet capture shows 1-3% packet loss + bursty retransmits on egress link. BGP shows repeated withdraws and re-adverts to that transit nexthop. I'm opening a ticket with provider NOC now.

tori-prod: Can we shift traffic to eu-west2b while provider resolves? We have spare capacity there.

sam.sre: Yes, preparing route-policy to steer hosted-api traffic away from eu-west2a -> provider-edge to eu-west2b pop. I'll apply a temporary traffic-split at the edge for customer-facing hostnames. Rolling route change at 09:52 UTC.

sam.sre: Command applied: `redwood-route set-hosted-hosts --src-pop eu-west2a --backup-pop eu-west2b --percent 100 --drain 2m`

deploy-bot: health-check: hosted-api-eu-west2a -> failing 5/5; hosted-api-eu-west2b -> healthy 5/5. Canary routing change complete.

ingest-sre: After the failover, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% and gateway latency p99 reduced to ~420ms. Still seeing elevated auth retries in logs — could be client-side token retries amplifying backend load earlier.

emma-support: Client-facing update sent at 09:55 UTC: "We've identified a regional peering disruption affecting eu-west2a. We've rerouted traffic to eu-west2b and are monitoring. Estimated provider repair time 30-60m. Support will follow up." :eyes: :thumbsup:

raj-net: Provider NOC confirmed partial outage on that POP due to an upstream fiber maintenance + BGP adjacency flaps. They report they're stabilizing links and will keep us updated — ETA ~45 minutes. We've requested a permanent mitigation plan and BGP dampening on their end.

sam.sre: Immediate mitigation summary:
- Traffic diverted from eu-west2a -> eu-west2b (09:52 UTC)
- Customer guidance: pin to eu-west2b if needed, and retry/backoff guidance shared
- Monitoring: enable per-pop BGP-flap alerts and add packet-loss on-egress alert threshold to 0.5% sustained

raj-net: Ongoing actions: collecting full pcap for postmortem, confirming whether route-reflectors saw the same withdraws, and asking provider for BGP FLAP logs.

ingest-sre: Noting correlated spike in auth token exchange rate that increased backend socket churn around the same time — postmortem item: add auth-retry suppression and circuit-breaker on token failures to avoid amplification.

emma-support: Customers requiring SLA credits? We'll shepherd escalations — flagging any account with >5 mins outage impact.

sam.sre: Will follow up with a short incident recap + action items after provider confirms resolution. Thanks all for rapid response.

raj-net: Provider reports incremental stabilization at 10:22 UTC, no further withdraws in last 4m. We'll keep metrics open for another 30m.

sam.sre: Closing active mitigation — leaving route back to default after 10:35 UTC once we confirm stability. Will post final note in INC-4598.

emma-support: Noted. I'll update customers with final timeline.

sam.sre: Post-incident immediate TODOs: 1) Auto-failover playbook review (make it <90s), 2) Add BGP adjacency-flap alert, 3) Add egress packet-loss alert and automated spillover policy.

raj-net: +1 add path-mesh healthcheck and provider PSR (point of service review).

emma-support: Good job — fast mitigation. Marking incident as "mitigated" and keeping open for postmortem write-up. :thumbsup:
